housing.summary: A one-bedroom apartment in Dallas city centre averages USD 1,713.92 per month; Zillow provides a Dallas rentals portal. No authoritative Dallas deposit norm expressed in months was found.

banking.summary: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN where one is required.

schools.summary: Dallas International School offers accredited French and U.S. independent-school education and the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme.

legal_admin.summary: For noncitizens subject to USCIS address reporting, a move must be reported within 10 days, normally through a USCIS online account; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days using the online change-of-address tool or Form AR-11, if subject to the requirement.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and required identity and foreign-status documentation unless an exception applies.

transport.summary: Dallas Area Rapid Transit (DART) operates Dallas buses, DART Rail, GoLink and included TRE service; the Local Monthly Pass costs USD 126.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid, unexpired foreign licence may be used for up to one year or until Texas residency begins, whichever is sooner; a new resident must apply for a Texas licence within 90 days. Source: https://www.dps.texas.gov/section/driver-license/driving-privilege-reciprocity
transport.healthcare_registration: Public coverage is eligibility-based, not automatic. Apply for Texas benefits through Your Texas Benefits and submit requested proof, which may include identity, Texas residence, income, and immigration status. Source: https://www.hhs.texas.gov/services/questions-about-your-benefits/benefits-application-next-steps
